subject: physical-education

location.unitTitle: Independent Training Cycle: Plan, Execute, Adjust
location.courseTitle: Lifelong Wellness and Independent Training Capstone

standardsMappingAuthority.note: Standards remain governed by the bound production package.

instructions: Complete the safe activity or accessible equivalent and document the requested performance evidence.
Stop for pain, dizziness, breathing trouble, unsafe conditions, or missing adult supervision.

learnerTasks.prompt: Explain the critical features or key principle of planning a cycle the learner will run unsupervised in your own words.
Demonstrate or fully describe self-monitoring by feel, performance, and adherence using a version your body and setting allow. A described or adapted version earns full credit.
Apply pre-committed rules for progressing, holding, and deloading in a new situation and explain the decision or adjustment you made.
Analyze a plausible technique fault, tactical error, or unsafe choice involving diagnosing a stalled cycle; correct it and explain why.
Connect adjusting mid-cycle without abandoning the plan with honest evaluation, including of a cycle that did not work and explain how one affects the other.

Present the strongest evidence from the unit task: Run a complete self-directed training cycle end to end, documenting every adjustment and its reason, and write an honest evaluation of what worked and what did not.
Identify one thing you can now do or direct yourself, one adjustment that improved it, and one next goal you set for yourself.

learnerSuccessCriteria: Provide evidence that meets the stated safe participation and self-management criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated skill cues or movement quality criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated tactical or training reasoning criterion.
Provide evidence that meets the stated self-assessment and revision criterion.
accommodations: Access supports may change format, pacing, intensity, range, equipment, setting, or response mode without changing the standard being assessed. An adapted or described performance is full credit, not partial credit.

provenance.unitObjective: How can the learner demonstrate the goals of Independent Training Cycle: Plan, Execute, Adjust?
